[[File:VSC-repack-box-sealed-Reddit-teabo.jpg|thumb|right|320px|Sealed Vintage Sports Cards box. Photo: Reddit user teabo.]]
'''Unofficial repackaged products''' are third-party retail bundles of genuine [[Decipher]] Star Wars card packs. They were sold in mass-market stores after [[Decipher and the Star Wars CCG Lucasfilm license|Decipher's Star Wars license]] ended on 31 December 2001.<ref name="icv2wotc">[https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/983/wizards-coast-gets-star-wars-ccg Wizards of the Coast Gets Star Wars CCG], ICv2. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008201620/https://icv2.com/articles/games/view/983/wizards-coast-gets-star-wars-ccg Internet Archive]</ref>

== Vintage Sports Cards boxes ==
[[File:VSC-repack-box-end-eBay-lou1c94.jpg|thumb|right|300px|End panel. Photo: eBay seller lou1.c_94.]]
Vintage Sports Cards, Inc. of Conroe, Texas, repacked card-game products for Toys "R" Us.<ref name="icv2konami">[https://icv2.com/print/article/13988 Konami Sues Vintage Sports Cards], ICv2 (27 December 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20241114084910/https://icv2.com/print/article/13988 Internet Archive]</ref> Its Star Wars repack is a window box titled "Collectible Card Game", with Episode I art and no Decipher logo, priced at $14.99 ("Over $45 Value").<ref name="bgg">[https://boardgamegeek.com/thread/2902121/i-need-assistance-identifying-this-set I need assistance identifying this set], BoardGameGeek, Star Wars Customizable Card Game forum (19 July 2022). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014003015/https://swccg.com/snapshots/ebay/287632079846.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="reddit">[https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/hx9o77/odd_display_box_of_random_boosters_anyone_know/ Odd display box of random boosters: anyone know about this?], r/starwarsccg (24 July 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20230615225919/https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/hx9o77/odd_display_box_of_random_boosters_anyone_know/ Internet Archive]. Comments: [https://arctic-shift.photon-reddit.com/api/comments/search?link_id=hx9o77&limit=100 Arctic Shift archive]</ref> A side panel states that the box contains genuine Star Wars cards "independently repackaged by Vintage Sports Cards, Inc. In Texas".<ref name="photo">Photograph of four boxes provided by [[Jeremy Christoffel]] (2026): [[:File:VSC-repack-boxes-Jeremy-Christoffel.jpg]]</ref> The box measures about 15.5 × 12 × 1 inches (UPC 730528700256).<ref name="ebay287">[https://www.ebay.com/itm/287632079846 Star Wars CCG Sealed Vintage Sports Cards Assortment Decipher 2001], eBay item 287632079846, seller lou1.c_94 (listing updated 13 October 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261014003015/https://swccg.com/snapshots/ebay/287632079846.html Internet Archive]</ref>

=== Contents ===
[[File:VSC-repack-box-sealed-BGG-KaosBound.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Sealed first-series box. Photo: BoardGameGeek user KaosBound.]]
The boxes came in two series.<ref name="bgg" />
* '''First series:''' one starter deck and ten boosters from SWCCG, [[Young Jedi]] and Jedi Knights, including [[Reflections]], [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] and [[Special Edition]] packs.
* '''Second series:''' twelve boosters and no starter, mostly early Young Jedi sets plus [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]], foreign-language and Unlimited SWCCG packs.

One sealed first-series box holds a [[Premiere Unlimited]] starter deck with [[Death Star II (expansion)|Death Star II]], Jabba's Palace, [[Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty|Reflections III]], Young Jedi and Jedi Knights packs. It was offered on eBay for $239.99 in October 2026.<ref name="ebay287" />

=== Where and when sold ===
[[File:VSC-repack-boxes-Jeremy-Christoffel.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Emptied boxes. Photo provided by [[Jeremy Christoffel]].]]
The boxes were sold at Kmart and Target from about 2002 to 2004.<ref name="bgg" /><ref name="reddit" /> Some boxes carry a "Fantastic Value For Only $9.99" sticker.<ref name="photo" />

== Other aftermarket sales ==
Big-box stores sold Young Jedi booster boxes for $9.99.<ref name="reddit" /> Dollar Tree sold single SWCCG packs, mostly Jabba's Palace, for $1 each in the mid-2000s, and still had Tatooine packs in 2011.<ref name="bgg" />
